operator: Use supplied Van Genuchten parameters theta_r/theta_s/Ksat_cm_day/alpha_cm_inv/l/n, m=1-1/n. Effective saturation=(1+(alpha*abs_head_cm)^n)^(-m); conductivity from sourceEq4 (equivalently Mualem saturation form). For ordered supplied suction-magnitude edges starting0, use conductivity at interval midpoint and delta_z_cm=delta_abs_head_cm*K/(K+q_mm_day/10). Stationary q is nonnegative upward; q0 gives hydrostatic z=abs_head exactly. Report lengths and flux units separately. No water stock, supply, recharge or crop benefit is created by this relation.

controls: Boundary saturation/conductivity, finite/physical parameters, cm/mm conversion, zero-flux hydrostatic profile, monotone depth versus flux, variable head increments, shape/broadcasting and rejected invalid inputs. Independent high-precision Decimal conductivity and midpoint recurrence on supplied soils; no producer/component import in reviewer. Fresh numeric source/benchmark outputs byte-exact.
limits: Steady unsaturated flow is a mathematical approximation; no field water-table history, root suction, hydraulic profile or aquifer geometry fitted. Butzer1976p19 describes analogues; p90summer depth cannot be reused as winter depth. FAO56approximate1m convention is distinct from soil-specific FAO61 curves. No universal capillary rate, extra root-zone TAW or unlimited groundwater inferred.
